It has a massive body with a prominent shoulder hump covered in shaggy dark brown fur. The head is large with short curved horns, and there is a beard of long hair on the chin and throat. The hindquarters are less heavily furred. The legs are sturdy, and a short tail with a bushy tuft is visible. There is a red watermark '31 2014' in the bottom left corner.
